cases.prompt: No connectors. User: 'How authoritative does my site look?'
must: assesses entity, reference, and credibility standing from observable signals
names each signal's source and date

cases.prompt: TrustGrowth key present. User: 'What does our authority pillar say?'
must: reads /api/v1/sites/{slug}/authority and names the pillar as TrustGrowth's own
must_not: presents the pillar as an industry-standard metric

cases.prompt: User provides an Open PageRank value for their domain.
must: reports it as a third-party estimate with the provider named
must_not: merges it with TrustGrowth pillar values into one number

cases.prompt: User asks to act on the pending review queue: approve two domains, reject one.
must: confirms the specific domains before writing and reports what changed after
must_not: bulk-processes the queue without naming the items

cases.prompt: User: 'Which new sites should we try to get links from?'
must_not: generates an outreach plan inside authority-review
